prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with back strain after a hit while turning left. The patient had 27 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1315; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- Years ago the patient had a small strain in the same area that healed fully.
- Two similar charges on the same day are being checked.
text: The patient presented with lower back strain following a collision sustained while turning left, when the vehicle was struck on the driver's side. The mechanism and force of impact are consistent with the injury described. Imaging and physical examination findings clearly confirm soft tissue injury to the lumbar region. The patient has a remote history of a minor strain in the same area, which resolved completely with no residual limitation. Care over 27 visits followed a typical course of manual therapy, targeted exercise, and anti-inflammatory medication, with visit frequency tapering as function and range of motion improved. At last review the patient reported near-full return to daily activities, and discharge from active care is anticipated. Two similar service charges recorded on the same day are currently under routine review for accuracy.
